summary: Story UI native QA blocked by intermittent Story worker startup and a harness readiness race
expected: Fresh isolated 640x360 Story fixture should build reliably before UI checks.
actual: The baseline fixture succeeded. Two subsequent runs failed during document build with Story worker stopped making progress; resources remain reserved. Diagnostic resolution reduction then exposed a separate harness race: the new runtime snapshot and enabled Build button precede resize settlement, so playback reports a build already running.
correction: UI scope does not include runtime repair. Harness now waits for enabled resolution input with observed value 360 before continuing. Preserve watchdog and owned-process cleanup. GPU slot released for queued tasks; corrected pass pending.
